snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Road Warrior
snippet.description:
More Death Race 2000 than Mad Max, but not the worst game out there. The graphics and sound are decent, anyway. The gameplay, little that there is, starts at 1:33. 

Choose a vehicle from the start screen (doesn't make much of a difference) and hit the road. The objective is to shoot a certain amount of cars/bikes as indicated bottom centre of the status panel. Only certain shot vehicles will count, and this is not indicated. 

If you crash into any vehicle, or they hit you from behind (kamikrazees!) then you lose gas. Bottom left in the status panel is your score. This increases with each vehicle you destroy and can be added to your fuel at the pitstop when you hit the space bar at any time. Hit fire here to stop refuelling and hit the road again from where you left off.

If you shoot a vehicle but drive into the explosion then it won't count, so drive carefully. Crash into the scenery and it's game over, same if you run out of gas.

The end sequence has a half-naked person run into your car. Your reward, I guess :)¬
